## Priority decision

Two product releases landed after the website's v1.0.15 state. v1.0.16 added portable native Windows session management and unified the hosted frontend and Controller deployment. v1.0.17 made the web app session-first.

The current app starts from a machine-level overview of running, recent, and stopped agents with token totals, coding-plan state, CPU/RSS, and process counts. Selecting one session opens Conversation, Process Tree & AI Prompts, Timeline, and Detailed Events. Portable agent-native history works on Windows, macOS, and Linux; `record` and eBPF-backed tracing remain Linux-only. Saved captures remain read-only rather than pretending to be live machines.

`/product/` already owns this end-to-end reader decision, so the cycle refreshes that canonical instead of creating a release-summary URL. Waiting until the next normal cycle also risks crossing the rolling 48-hour substantive-content target.

## Rendered scope

The branch updates current release metadata to v1.0.17 and refreshes Product, Architecture, Pricing, Changelog, `llms.txt`, and product-route sitemap freshness. Architecture is pinned to the current Node/Direct/Controller implementation. Pricing now distinguishes the Free/Pro/Team/Enterprise catalog from the current hosted preview, where billing gates are not enforced and registered users receive the implemented hosted feature set.
